spec.claim_summary: Enter when the 8-day and 21-day EMAs cross, monitor for up to 6 days and exit if price crosses the 21-day EMA.

claimed.other: produced much more profit than loss. 6 positions were taken in 10 months (304 days), an average of one every 51 days.

assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim states only 'The 8 day and 21 day EMAs cross' with no long/short side; schema requires single direction so only bullish cross long side is tested.
Asset assumed BTCUSDT: claim text names no asset; page context is about BTC.
Timeframe assumed 1d because EMAs are quoted in days.
Entry assumed on the cross bar close with fill next open per engine convention.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: stop just the other side of the 21 day EMA and adjust daily is a dynamic EMA-based trailing stop; approximated as an exit when close crosses below the 21-day EMA.

evidence.quote: The 8 day and 21 day EMAs cross.
If price crosses the 21 day EMA , your setup has failed.
then monitor for a maximum of 6 days.

audit_majors: direction: Claim says only 'The 8 day and 21 day EMAs cross' with no side, implying both bullish and bearish crosses. Spec tests only long crosses_above and omits the short side, which changes trade count and P/L.
